about: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B GPTQ Int4 with its MTP head (4 draft tokens) on one Intel Arc Pro B70: Intel's llm-scaler vLLM 0.26.1 for XPU, XPU graphs on, fp8 KV, vision on, 262K context
args: mkdir -p /dev/dri/by-path && for r in /dev/dri/renderD*; do ln -sf "../${r##*/}" "/dev/dri/by-path/pci-$(basename "$(readlink -f "/sys/class/drm/${r##*/}/device")")-render"; done; source /opt/intel/oneapi/setvars.sh --force && source /opt/intel/oneapi/ccl/2021.15/env/vars.sh --force && exec vllm serve "$@"
setup: NEEDS: one Intel Arc Pro B70 32 GB, only its render node passed in (no --ipc host, no seccomp or capability flags). The entrypoint is the image's own (oneAPI + oneCCL env, then vllm serve) preceded by one step: it links each passed render node under /dev/dri/by-path/pci-<bdf>-render inside the container, because oneCCL's single-rank init (vLLM XPU worker all_reduce) opens /dev/dri/by-path and fails with 'opendir failed: could not open device directory' when only the render node is passed. VLLM_XPU_ENABLE_XPU_GRAPH=1: decode 86 tok/s with XPU graphs vs 30.5 tok/s eager on the same launch (C1, 600-word story, natural end; MTP mean acceptance length 4.5-4.7). Memory on the card: weights 22.63 GiB (GPTQ Int4 + MTP head + vision tower), XPU graphs 2.3 GiB, fp8 KV 3.89 GiB = 298,645 tokens. First request after start is slow (~25 s to first token: one-time compile). Measured on omarchy (EPYC 7443P, Arc Pro B70 at 0000:84:00.0, xe driver).
